data.name: Qaimaan
data.gender_notes: Qaimaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qaimaan is an Arabic name that signifies rising or ascending, symbolizing growth and progress. It is a name that encourages the bearer to strive for excellence and reach new heights. The name Qaimaan carries the meaning “Rising, Ascending” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qaimaan usually hope their child will grow to embody rising, ascending and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Qaimaan is reminiscent of the Quranic concept of spiritual ascension, where believers strive to rise closer to Allah through righteous deeds and devotion.
data.etymology: Qaimaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rising, Ascending.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaimaan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: قيمان
in_arabic.meaning: قيمان يعني الثابت القائم المداوم على الشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قيمان من الأسماء العربية التي تعني الثابت القائم المداوم على الشيء، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الصالحين الذين يقيمون الصلاة ويؤتون الزكاة. وقيمان هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الالتزام والثبات في الدين والعمل الصالح.

in_urdu.name: قیامان
in_urdu.meaning: قیامان مطلب ہے دائم و ثابت قدیم بندہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: قیامان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے دائم و ثابت قدیم بندہ۔ اس نام کی اصلیت عربی زبان سے ہے اور قرآن کریم میں بھی اس جیسے الفاظ ملتے ہیں جو دائمی اور ثابت رہنے کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں۔ اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بھی کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़यामान
in_hindi.meaning: क़यामान का अर्थ है स्थिर और निरंतर
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़यामान एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है स्थिर और निरंतर। यह नाम उन विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है जो इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण मानी जाती हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इस नाम का उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: قيمان
in_pashto.meaning: قيمان د معنی دا لری دایمي او ثابت
in_pashto.long_meaning: قيمان د عربي نوم دی چې دایمي او ثابت معنی لري. دا نوم د هغو ځانګړتیاوو څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي کوم چې د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره سمون لري.

Historically, names like Qaimaan have been used across various Muslim cultures to denote spiritual and moral strength.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qaimaan holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as it is associated with Qiamah - the day of reckoning, the time of the greatest earthquake, when God Judges all mankind. In this context, the name Qaimaan serves as a powerful reminder of the end-time, encouraging Muslims to lead righteous lives and prepare for the journey after death. This connection to the end of times adds an edge of determination and urgency, inspiring those who bear or hear the name to aim for constant growth, development and improvement in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Qaimaan lies in its root meaning, which suggests ascension, rising or climbing towards a higher state. In religious and philosophical contexts, it often refers to the spiritual journey of a person, the progress towards self-improvement, and the quest for nearness to the divine. Muslims believe that everyone embarks on this journey in life, aiming to purify their hearts, deepen their faith, and ultimately, transcend their material existence. Therefore, the name Qaimaan can be seen as a reminder of this ultimate spiritual goal, inspiring belivers to focus on their spiritual growth and progress, and consistently work towards nearness to Allah.
